text:
anya: Quick sync — we have a planned SDK change that tightens auth behavior and renames the `batch_size` param to `batch` for consistency. Goal: zero-downtime for partners. thoughts?

sam: 👍 from infra side — feature flag + header negotiation should handle it. need a compatibility matrix and canary plan.

mike: Agree. Also need to validate downstream SI integrations (they often hardcode query params). Can we provide a shim?

lisa: We can add a runtime shim in the hosted proxy for 2 weeks (translates `batch` -> `batch_size`). That buys partners time.

anya: Good. Proposed pieces: 1) header-based opt-in 2) proxy shim for a limited window 3) partner-facing migration guide + playbook link 4) phased canary by region and partner tier.

sam: For the header negotiation, suggested header: `X-Redwood-SDK-Compat: v2` — server will prefer explicit header if present, else default to v1 behavior. Example: 
```
# client example
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -H \"X-Redwood-SDK-Compat: v2\" \n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"batch":10}'
```

cloud-partner-rep: @anya thanks — can we get a test endpoint? partners want to smoke before opt-in.

lisa: We can stand up `compat-v2-test.redwood.ai` tomorrow. Will add docs + sample clients (python/js).

anya: Great. Draft timeline:
- Day 0: announce migration window + partner survey (ask who needs shims)
- Day 3: enable test endpoint + send SDK samples
- Day 7: start opt-in canary (5 partners, eu/us mix)
- Day 14: enable proxy shim for all partners (translates `batch`->`batch_size`)
- Day 30: soft-deprecate v1 auth pattern; start automated telemetry to find non-opt-ins
- Day 45: remove shim and flip default to v2 behavior (final rollback window: 48h)

mike: Add SRE checklist: tracing for header, spike detection (delta error rate), rate-limit exceptions, rollback playbook link. I can own the SRE checklist.

anya: Owners:
- Partner comms & onboarding: anya
- Test endpoint + sample clients: lisa
- SRE monitoring & rollback: mike
- Partner liaison & triage: cloud-partner-rep

sam: Small note: doc the exact auth tightening — switching to `x-rw-user` header required for delegated calls. We'll include examples.

cloud-partner-rep: Sounds good. I'll push to partner POC list and collect compatibility concerns. Can we add a lightweight telemetry event so partners can opt-in to share errors?

lisa: Yes, we'll add `compat_migration_event` telemetry with partner id + opt-in flag. GDPR-safe.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for compat service — canary id `c-2026-03-21-1` (5% traffic).

mike: Noted: watching canary metrics. ping me if error rate > 0.5% over 5m.

anya: OK — I'll draft the partner email and migration guide tonight and post in #partnerships tomorrow AM. Thanks team :thumbsup:
